scripts.dev: cd services/catalog && ([ -f .dev.vars ] || cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars) && pnpm run migrate:local && wrangler dev -c ../gateway/wrangler.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc -c ../verification/wrangler.jsonc $([ -f ../moderation/wrangler.jsonc ] && echo -c ../moderation/wrangler.jsonc) --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.typecheck:moderation: if [ -f services/moderation/package.json ]; then pnpm --dir services/moderation typecheck; else echo 'services/moderation is not checked out (private submodule).'; fi
scripts.test:moderation: if [ -f services/moderation/package.json ]; then pnpm --dir services/moderation test; else echo 'services/moderation is not checked out (private submodule).'; fi
